requirements.description: The user prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes A1 through A4, B and C. Energy score values cannot separate C from D-E, so energy_class is used directly. The 850 sqm area, 60-person capacity and public transport proximity are not energy requirements and are not included.
User states proximity to public transport is preferred. Value set at the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution.

A university student residence is inherently tied to nearby universities and schools, so education proximity is essential. Value set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 60 people, the energy class C preference, and the public transport proximity are not gross-area requirements or REFERENCE COLUMNS, so they are not converted into filters.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the office property type (mapped to the filterable property_type column, since tipologia_bene_immobile is not filterable), surface_area >= 850, a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892, energy_class in A1–C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the given coordinates. The 60-person capacity has no matching filterable column, so it is not applied.
